duration: School year (September to June) and summer (June to August)
notes: The page lists no training or hours rule. Email the library with questions. As of Nov 4, 2026, the library site blocked automated reading, so confirm first.
name: Volunteens (teen volunteers)
what_you_do: In the school year, sort and shelve materials and help with program supplies and office work. In summer, help patrons join the Summer Reading Club and do special projects.
who_can_apply: Teens who are at least 12 or entering grades 7 to 12 in the fall.
deadline_text: No deadline was posted as of Oct 19, 2026. Check the page to see if the library is taking new volunteers.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Volunteens application. The library will contact you if you are approved.
